en.title: Kim Jong Un urges North Korea to seize 'absolute superiority' in drone technology
en.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un called for his country to seize "absolute superiority" in drone technology at an unmanned aeronautical technology exhibition and weapons demonstration, state media KCNA reported; a firepower demonstration followed, involving tactical suicide attack drones, tactical cruise missiles and multi-purpose drones.
body: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un told an unmanned aeronautical technology exhibition and weapons demonstration that his country should achieve 'absolute superiority' in drone technology, according to state media KCNA.

KCNA said a firepower demonstration followed the exhibition, featuring tactical suicide attack drones, tactical cruise missiles, multi-purpose drones and a battalion of 600mm multiple rocket launchers.

zh.title: 金正恩要求北韓在無人機技術上掌握絕對優勢、展覽後舉行火力示範
zh.summary: 據朝中社報導，北韓領導人金正恩在無人航空技術展覽與武器示範活動上發言，要求北韓在無人機技術上掌握絕對優勢；展覽後舉行的火力示範動用了戰術自殺式攻擊無人機、戰術巡弋飛彈與多用途無人機。
body: 據朝中社報導，北韓領導人金正恩在一場無人航空技術展覽與武器示範活動上發言，要求北韓在無人機技術上掌握絕對優勢。
展覽後接著舉行火力示範，朝中社稱示範動用了戰術自殺式攻擊無人機、戰術巡弋飛彈、多用途無人機，以及一個600毫米多管火箭發射器營。
